title: 5 s window, 0 % overlap · total torque
description: Total-torque version (nothing subtracted): 5 s window (100 steps of 50 ms) with 0 % overlap between consecutive training windows: a new training window every 5000 ms (1/500 of the windows of the "Length 5 s" setting, which starts a window every 10 ms). Validation and test keep every window. Caveat: fewer windows also means proportionally fewer weight updates per epoch under the same epoch limit, so this changes the amount of training as well as the overlap. With this few training windows the model may barely train at all. Everything else as the reference: Active torque (each session's own relaxed-hold passive torque subtracted), EMG ÷ session-1 maximum, no per-angle loss scaling (plain mean-squared error, every angle weighted by its own torque), LSTM 8×2 trained with batch 64 (fast protocol: learning rate × 0.5 after 6 flat epochs, early stop 15, at most 150 epochs), trained on session 1 and tested on session 2, 6 people × 10 seeds. The EMG envelope is causal (forward-only filters: no input uses later EMG, as in a real-time device; 2nd-order 2 Hz low-pass, about 125 ms lag) and the first and last 1 s of every trial are cut. Validation windows start one window span after the training part of each trial, so no validation window reuses training inputs (purged split).
